column1: # Host tools the CI gates run beyond the native assembler and linker that
# CONTRIBUTING.md names. Before the first gate starts, scripts/ci-verify.sh
# checks the rows of every selected gate, so a host that lacks a tool fails at
# once, naming the tool, its gates and how to install it, rather than after the
# gates before it. A missing tool is never a reason to skip a gate: install it.
# tool: the display name. hosts: all, linux or windows. gates: the IDs of the
# scripts/ci-gates.tsv rows that run the tool on those hosts, each of which runs
# on all of them. check: shell text evaluated in the checkout root, succeeding
# when the tool is usable. install: how to get the tool.

column4: command -v as && command -v ld && command -v readelf && command -v strip
column5: install GNU binutils (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install binutils; Fedora: dnf install binutils; Arch: pacman -S binutils)

column4: command -v objdump || { command -v llvm-readobj && command -v llvm-objdump; }
column5: install GNU binutils or LLVM (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install binutils; Fedora: dnf install binutils; Arch: pacman -S binutils)
install GCC or Clang so that cc is on PATH (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install gcc; Fedora: dnf install gcc; Arch: pacman -S gcc)
install Clang, which compiles the C baselines (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install clang; Fedora: dnf install clang; Arch: pacman -S clang)
install Valgrind, whose Cachegrind counts instructions (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install valgrind; Fedora: dnf install valgrind; Arch: pacman -S valgrind)
install GNU time at /usr/bin/time (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install time; Fedora: dnf install time; Arch: pacman -S time) or set TLCI_NATIVE_ROUTE_TIME_BIN to a GNU time binary
install GNU time at /usr/bin/time (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install time; Fedora: dnf install time; Arch: pacman -S time) or set DOC_SITE_TIME_BIN to a GNU time binary
install jq (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install jq; Fedora: dnf install jq; Arch: pacman -S jq; Windows: winget install jqlang.jq)
